# gl-transitions

> The open collection of GL Transitions: 125 GLSL shaders that turn one image into another as `progress` goes from 0 to 1. Each one is also published as an SkSL runtime effect for Skia. This document describes gl-transitions@1.76.1 (npm).

Every transition is GLSL (WebGL 1 / GLSL ES 1.00) that implements `vec4 transition(vec2 uv)`. The host provides:

- `float progress`: 0.0 shows only the outgoing image, 1.0 only the incoming one
- `float ratio`: output width / height
- `vec4 getFromColor(vec2 uv)` and `vec4 getToColor(vec2 uv)`: sample the outgoing and incoming images (uv in [0, 1], origin at the bottom left)
- one uniform per parameter, set to its default unless the user picks another value
- one `sampler2D` per extra texture, for the few transitions that list `textures`

SkSL versions (`sksl/<name>.sksl`) are standalone Skia runtime effects: children `_from`, `_to` (then one per extra texture), uniforms `float2 _resolution` (output size in pixels), `progress`, `ratio` and each parameter by name (`bool` parameters are `int` 0 or 1), entry point `half4 main(float2 coord)` with a top-left origin. Draw both images at the output size.

Install: `npm install gl-transitions` (`import transitions from "gl-transitions"`), or fetch the files below. Latest version: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1/

## AdvancedMosaic

Both images break into large blocks that blend, then sharpen into the incoming image

- Tags: pixelate, mosaic, blend
- Parameters:
  - `pixelSize` (float = 50)
- Author: Sergey Kosarevsky
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/AdvancedMosaic.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/sksl/AdvancedMosaic.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/AdvancedMosaic

## BlockDissolve

The incoming image appears in small random blocks

- Tags: dissolve, blocks, noise
- Parameters:
  - `blocksize` (float = 0.02)
- Author: nwoeanhinnogaehr
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/BlockDissolve.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/sksl/BlockDissolve.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/BlockDissolve

## BookFlip

The outgoing image turns like a book page from right to left, revealing the incoming one

- Tags: page, flip, 3d
- Parameters: none
- Author: hong
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/BookFlip.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/sksl/BookFlip.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/BookFlip

## Bounce

The outgoing image drops out of the frame with a few bounces, revealing the incoming one

- Tags: bounce, slide, vertical, shadow
- Parameters:
  - `shadow_colour` (vec4 = vec4(0, 0, 0, 0.6)) [color]: Color of the shadow cast on the incoming image
  - `shadow_height` (float = 0.075) [range 0.01 to 0.5]: Height of the shadow, relative to the image height
  - `bounces` (float = 3) [range 1 to 10 step 1]: Number of bounces before settling
- Author: Adrian Purser
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/Bounce.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/sksl/Bounce.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/Bounce

Two triangles grow from the left and right edges into a bow tie that reveals the incoming image

- Tags: wipe, shape, horizontal
- Parameters: none
- Author: huynx
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/BowTieHorizontal.glsl

- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/BowTieHorizontal

## BowTieWithParameter

A bow-tie wipe with an adjustable shape that can run in reverse

- Tags: wipe, shape
- Parameters:
  - `adjust` (float = 0.5)
  - `reverse` (bool = false): Run the wipe in reverse
- Author: KMojek
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/BowTieWithParameter.glsl

## Box

The outgoing image shrinks into a box, toward the center or a corner, revealing the incoming one

- Tags: box, zoom, shape
- Parameters:
  - `rectIn` (int = 1)
  - `location` (int = 0) [range 0 to 4 step 1]: Where the box goes: 0 center, 1 left top, 2 left bottom, 3 right top, 4 right bottom
- Author: lql
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/Box.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/sksl/Box.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/Box

## ButterflyWaveScrawler

Wavy, color-separated ripples scramble the outgoing image into the incoming one

- Tags: wave, distort, chromatic
- Parameters:
  - `amplitude` (float = 1)
  - `waves` (float = 30)
  - `colorSeparation` (float = 0.3)
- Author: mandubian
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/ButterflyWaveScrawler.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/sksl/ButterflyWaveScrawler.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/ButterflyWaveScrawler

## GridFlip

The image splits into a grid of tiles that flip one by one to the incoming image

- Tags: grid, tiles, flip
- Parameters:
  - `size` (ivec2 = ivec2(4, 4)): Number of tiles (columns, rows)
  - `pause` (float = 0.1)
  - `dividerWidth` (float = 0.05)
  - `bgcolor` (vec4 = vec4(0, 0, 0, 1)) [color]: Color behind the tiles
  - `randomness` (float = 0.1)
- Author: TimDonselaar
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/GridFlip.glsl

## Revolve_Left

The outgoing image swirls and zooms with motion blur into the incoming one

- Tags: swirl, zoom, rotate, blur
- Parameters:
  - `center` (vec2 = vec2(0.46, 0.52)): Center of the swirl
  - `direction` (float = -1)
  - `maxRotation` (float = 1.95)
  - `peakZoom` (float = 2.22)
  - `swirl` (float = 2.85)
  - `barrel` (float = 0.38)
  - `motionBlur` (float = 1)
  - `switchStart` (float = 0.3)
  - `switchEnd` (float = 0.5)
  - `shadow` (float = 0.16)
- Author: bread
- License: MIT
- GLSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/transitions/Revolve_Left.glsl
- SkSL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gl-transitions@1.76.1/sksl/Revolve_Left.sksl
- Preview: https://gl-transitions.com/editor/Revolve_Left

- Tags: rotate, roll
- Parameters:

  - `RotDown` (bool = false): Roll the outgoing image down instead of up
- Author: Mark Craig

## RotateScaleVanish

The outgoing image spins and shrinks away over the incoming one

- Tags: rotate, zoom, spin
- Parameters:
  - `FadeInSecond` (bool = true): Fade in the incoming image
  - `ReverseEffect` (bool = false): Run the effect in reverse
  - `ReverseRotation` (bool = false): Rotate the other way
- Author: Mark Craig
- License: MIT
